_about: GHSA-h2mr-m3v3-cq8c shared cases. Every framework feeds each URL below (for each scheme it supports) to its REAL redact, parse and connect/error paths and asserts that no output - redacted string, exception message, exception cause/previous chain, log line - contains any of the secret fragments. Hosts, users and db names never contain a fragment.
known_unmaskable: A host-less URL whose password is all digits (postgres://u:123/x) cannot be told apart from a port; not in this list, and documented.
redacted_must_keep: the scheme, the user and the host (dbhost) where one exists, so the log line is still useful
_added: Digit-led passwords (12?..., 12...) added after the Ruby mutation run: a whole-value URI parser reads u:12?x@h as host u, port 12.
